obligations.statement: The product must send a signal to the machine when the pedal is pressed.
derivation_premises: REQ-0001 states a functional requirement to send a signal.

obligations.statement: The pedal must return to its resting position on its own when the foot is removed.
The pedal must not move when something brushes against it sideways.
derivation_premises: REQ-0003 requires resistance to sideways force.

candidates.summary: A pedal that rotates about a pivot and uses a spring to return and a detent to resist sideways motion.

evidence_route_verdict.note: Rotation and return path can be checked.

candidates.summary: A pedal that translates linearly and uses a spring to return and a guide to prevent sideways motion.
A pedal that uses a compliant flexure to deform and return, with geometry resisting sideways motion.

predicates: The pedal rotates around a fixed axis.
The pedal returns to its resting position when released.
The pedal remains stationary when a sideways force is applied.
The pedal translates along a straight line.
The pedal returns to its resting position when released.
The pedal does not move sideways.
The pedal deforms elastically when pressed.
The pedal returns to its resting position when released.

unresolved.decision: Choice of mechanism for sending signal
unresolved.why_open: The requirement REQ-0001 does not specify the type of signal, and the mechanism for sending it is not defined.
The requirement REQ-0003 is ambiguous about what 'something' refers to, affecting the design of resistance.

assumptions.statement: The foot pedal is intended for a workbench machine that accepts an input signal.
assumptions.why: It is implied by the request.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: if the machine does not accept signals
